ACT I
(MUSIC IN [I, #1]. Lights rise on a harbour. A BOY
skips stones.)
A BOY. You talk funny.
WREN. I do not.
BOY (lines overlapping with WREN's). Funny, funny,
funny...
WREN. Stop it! (MUSIC OUT.)
Page 10 THE LIGHTHOUSE KEY Act I
BOY. Make me.
WREN. I'll tell. (She looks at the BOY who does not re-
spond.) I will!
(BOY runs off. MUSIC IN [I, #2] for scene change as
WREN walks to the lighthouse.)
KEEPER. You'll be the girl, then.
Act I THE LIGHTHOUSE KEY Page 11
WREN. I'm nobody's girl.
KEEPER. Aye, that's plain enough.
Page 12
THE LIGHTHOUSE KEY
Act I
WREN. What's that tower?
KEEPER. Never you mind. (He goes back to work. WREN
kicks the ground when suddenly a GULL cries.)
Dang that bird.
Act I
THE LIGHTHOUSE KEY
Page 13
WREN. Does it have a name?
KEEPER. Gulls don't have names.
ACT II
Page 14
(Night. The tower door.)
WREN. It's locked.
